originality.rationale: The exact model rate definitions and three-regime environment are sourced, not claimed as new. The original 2023 paper primarily develops stationary-distribution and linear-noise approaches and does not state the exact stationary two-time covariance for the full finite stochastic count model. Neither accessible 2016 switching-noise methods nor 2018 network-voter correlation work establishes the all-N additive one-exponential correction with positive closed coefficient. published-finding corpus semantic searches found no identical theorem. General exact moment closure and unpublished equivalent derivations remain a real residual priority risk.
residual_risks: A more general exact moment-closure or Markov-modulated reaction-network result might imply the correction without presenting the same model parameters.
